## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][25]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][26]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][27].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][28]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][29]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][30]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][31].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][32]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# PRIVILEGED GASTRONOMY

# Reservations & Special Orders

#### Caviar Selections

The finest Caviar is a luxury that is extremely enjoyable to the palette. Caviar Direct specializes
in offering high-quality, mildly cured masterpieces. We ensure the proper details that define
excellence with all our Caviar so you are assured of ultimate enjoyment.

Discover a variety of different Caviar Selections in person. We recommend making a reservation,
especially during busy holidays.

#### Artisanal Smoked Salmon Sides

Our Smoked Salmon recipes have been developed over decades. The Salmon sides take about a week to
produce and are carefully handcrafted according to tradition. If you are purchasing full sides of
Salmon for a party, family celebration, or travel, please get in touch with us a couple of weeks
ahead so that we can guarantee availability and proper packaging for travel. Pick up at the
business.

#### Special Order Fresh Truffles

**We sell** **fresh European Truffles** **ONLY by prepaid order.**  You pay ahead to pick up later
in-store at a scheduled week (allow a minimum of two weeks ahead per order). These wild, perishable
luxuries are carefully located, grade-selected, and ripened in native European soils. We only import
at the key time of individual truffle quality. You can then pick up your Truffle(s) in person at our
boutique. They should be served within 4 days for ultimate enjoyment. We exclusively purvey top
quality. Each season, these are EXTREMELY LIMITED in availability.

**We ALSO regularly stock a range of preserved Truffle Products at the store.**  These are much more
affordable, and make excellent Travel Gifts.

# Discover us in person

**Visit our boutique in the historic St. Lawrence Market.** We can then recognize you as a member of
our loyal clientele who have patronized us for decades. **Many of our elite products are limited in
production or seasonally available and thus not suitable for online sale.**

At Caviar Direct, we cherish our journey that started over 35 years ago, bringing you the finest
luxury Caviar, Smoked Salmon selections, Truffle Products and Gourmet Travel Gifts. Our story is one
of passion and dedication, crafted through inspiration and a love for gourmet delicacies. Join us as
we continue to celebrate our curated selections of taste.

## Caviar 101

What is caviar?

Caviar is the roe of sturgeon, lightly salted in the traditional malossol method to draw out its
flavor. Long prized as a delicacy, it's served as a garnish or a spread — a natural centerpiece for
a celebration, or a quiet indulgence.

Traditionally, the term referred only to roe from wild sturgeon in the Caspian and Black Seas — the
classic Beluga, Osetra, and Sevruga. Today, caviar is farmed around the world and spans a wider
range of sturgeon, including Sterlet, Siberian, and Pacific. The name is also used more broadly for
the roe of other fish, such as salmon and trout.

What's the difference between caviar and roe?

Roe is the general term for the eggs of any fish. Caviar refers specifically to sturgeon roe, cured
with salt — the only roe that carries the name.

What are the different types of caviar?

The classic three come from wild Caspian sturgeon: Beluga, Osetra, and Sevruga. Farming has since
widened the field, and the caviars commonly sold today also include Sterlet, Siberian, and Pacific
sturgeon, as well as Kaluga.

Caviar Russe specializes in Osetra — from Classic through the rare Almas grades — alongside a select
range of other sturgeon.

How is our caviar shipped?

All of our caviar is available for purchase from our boutiques in New York and Miami, and our online
caviar store for delivery and pickup. Caviar Russe New York, awarded a Michelin star each of the
past 10 years, is located on Madison Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, and Caviar Russe Miami is located
on Brickell Avenue in Downtown Miami.

Caviar Russe offers next-day express overnight FedEx delivery nationwide, for all of our caviar and
gourmet foods. FedEx generally delivers by early afternoon but delivery time will vary by region and
location. local delivery is available in Manhattan and Miami. In addition, Caviar Russe offers same
day pickup in both of Caviar Russe’s locations in New York and Miami.

### About Company

Empire Foods, a division of Empire Industries Limited, is a 126 years old public limited company
listed on the Mumbai stock exchange. It is a multifaceted conglomerate with an interest in diverse
business and assets of more than one billion US dollars. We are one of the largest importers and
distributors of frozen food in India. We import all kinds of seafood, meat, dairy, bakery and other
vegetarian products from all over the globe.

Empire Foods operates a well-established, state-of-the-art cold-chain distribution system across
India. Utilizing strategically located refrigeration facilities and dedicated teams of experts, our
logistics network ensures the freshness and integrity of every product during transit. This
guarantees swift and timely delivery, ensuring our customers receive the best quality products no
matter where they are in India. Through these industry best practices, Empire Foods continues to set
new standards in the frozen and chilled foods segment of India.
* ###### Our Mission
  
  To deliver high-quality, reliable food solutions that create value for customers.
* ###### Our Vision
  
  To be a leading and trusted food industry partner, recognized for innovation.

small-to-medium grain, ranging from dark brown to black. It has a milder, more delicate, slightly
earthy flavor compared to oscietra, and is one of the most widely farmed varieties today (since wild

Royal Kaviar KelugaKeluga caviar comes from a hybrid sturgeon (kaluga x beluga cross), farmed as a

with a rich, creamy, buttery flavor close to beluga — offering similar luxury and texture at a more
accessible price point.
Persika Beluga"Persika Beluga" isn't a distinct caviar variety — Persika is an Iranian caviar
house/brand (French market), and their Beluga is true beluga caviar from Huso huso sturgeon out of
Iran. It's large-grain, light grey to dark grey (steel-grey), with a buttery, delicate, velvety
flavor. So it's beluga caviar branded under the Persika label, not a separate species or type.

# Salmon Fish

Salmon belongs to the family *Salmonidae*. Salmon are known for their streamlined body and silvery
skin, with a unique ability to migrate between freshwater and saltwater. They are born in rivers,
migrate to the ocean where they spend most of their lives, and return to freshwater to spawn. Salmon
are powerful swimmers and play an important role in both natural ecosystems and human diets.

## Habitat and Fishing Grounds

Salmon naturally inhabit the cold waters of the North Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. In Iran, salmon
farming has expanded in northern provinces near the Caspian Sea and in some western regions with
suitable cold-water resources. Salmon production is important both for local consumption and for
export to international markets.

## Mottra Farm

SIA “MOTTRA” was established in 2002 in Latvia. It utilizes a closed-recirculating system of its own
design, making the process of growing fish and processing it: ecological, sustainable, fish and
environmentally.

Technology that is being used, has been designed in the beginning of 1990’s in Astrakhan, capital of
caviar production. It has been evolving ever since to keep up with the time and a new methodology.
Numerous patents allow SIA “MOTTRA” to have the most sophisticated closed recalculation systems.

The team is comprised of professionals with 40 year experience in fish production. The leading
biologists finished institute in Astrakhan with a specialization in sturgeon fish farming.

In 2007, SIA “MOTTRA” had received a caviar for the first time and thus laid the foundation to
Mottra Caviar House.

## Why Mottra

#### Crystal clean
#### pure caviar

Crystal clean pure caviar without any preservatives or any other chemicals that found in the caviar
from other producers.

#### No antibiotics
#### are used

No antibiotics are used due to fish tanks being concealed in the building from environment impact on
the livelihood of fish. No need to treat the fish due to absence of flying birds which transport
diseases in nature.

#### Pure artesian
#### water

Water is taken from artesian drill of 150 m deep for caviar production. Free of heavy metals,
radionuclide, pesticides, dioxins and other by-products of modern human life, which surrounds all of
us in everyday day life.

#### Always fresh
#### caviar

Unlike other producers who produce caviar only once in a Spring and Autumn, MOTTRA CAVIAR is
producing it everyday throughout the whole year, so on the Christmas Eve caviar will be as fresh as
on the Easter Holiday.

#### Perfect texture
#### & taste

Perfect texture and taste that has been reached by the know-how and the care caviar.

## *Black Label*

##### The Black Label Caviar is as close to 100% sustainable and CO2 neutral as we can come in the
##### world of caviar.

Our Black Label caviar originates from the sturgeon Dauricus Schrenkii. The caviar is extracted when
the sturgeon reaches its second maturation at 12 years old, weighing between 65-105 kilograms.
Extracting the caviar at second maturation enhances its flavor and characteristics to create a truly
exquisite caviar that is superior in taste. The caviar matures for up to 12 weeks resulting in a
firm grain with a satisfyingly crisp texture, with a slightly nutty yet creamy taste that is both
bold and refined.

At Rossini Caviar we are dedicated to setting new standards of quality and we work tirelessly to be
in the position among the world’s best within our field. Rossini Caviar is more than just a supplier
of the world’s finest caviar to Michelin-starred restaurants.

We are a sparring partner to top chefs, working collaboratively to develop innovative culinary
creations that elevate the dining experience to new heights.

 

We work diligently with to understand a chef’s vision, share our expertise, and help create unique
dishes that showcase the delicate flavors of our caviar.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][25]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][26]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][27].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][28]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][29]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][30]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][31].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][32]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# Reservations & Special Orders

#### Caviar Selections

The finest Caviar is a luxury that is extremely enjoyable to the palette. Caviar Direct specializes
in offering high-quality, mildly cured masterpieces. We ensure the proper details that define
excellence with all our Caviar so you are assured of ultimate enjoyment.

Discover a variety of different Caviar Selections in person. We recommend making a reservation,
especially during busy holidays.

#### Artisanal Smoked Salmon Sides

Our Smoked Salmon recipes have been developed over decades. The Salmon sides take about a week to
produce and are carefully handcrafted according to tradition. If you are purchasing full sides of
Salmon for a party, family celebration, or travel, please get in touch with us a couple of weeks
ahead so that we can guarantee availability and proper packaging for travel. Pick up at the
business.

#### Special Order Fresh Truffles

**We sell** **fresh European Truffles** **ONLY by prepaid order.**  You pay ahead to pick up later
in-store at a scheduled week (allow a minimum of two weeks ahead per order). These wild, perishable
luxuries are carefully located, grade-selected, and ripened in native European soils. We only import
at the key time of individual truffle quality. You can then pick up your Truffle(s) in person at our
boutique. They should be served within 4 days for ultimate enjoyment. We exclusively purvey top
quality. Each season, these are EXTREMELY LIMITED in availability.

**We ALSO regularly stock a range of preserved Truffle Products at the store.**  These are much more
affordable, and make excellent Travel Gifts.

# Discover us in person

**Visit our boutique in the historic St. Lawrence Market.** We can then recognize you as a member of
our loyal clientele who have patronized us for decades. **Many of our elite products are limited in
production or seasonally available and thus not suitable for online sale.**

At Caviar Direct, we cherish our journey that started over 35 years ago, bringing you the finest
luxury Caviar, Smoked Salmon selections, Truffle Products and Gourmet Travel Gifts. Our story is one
of passion and dedication, crafted through inspiration and a love for gourmet delicacies. Join us as
we continue to celebrate our curated selections of taste.

## Caviar 101

What is caviar?

Caviar is the roe of sturgeon, lightly salted in the traditional malossol method to draw out its
flavor. Long prized as a delicacy, it's served as a garnish or a spread — a natural centerpiece for
a celebration, or a quiet indulgence.

Traditionally, the term referred only to roe from wild sturgeon in the Caspian and Black Seas — the
classic Beluga, Osetra, and Sevruga. Today, caviar is farmed around the world and spans a wider
range of sturgeon, including Sterlet, Siberian, and Pacific. The name is also used more broadly for
the roe of other fish, such as salmon and trout.

What's the difference between caviar and roe?

Roe is the general term for the eggs of any fish. Caviar refers specifically to sturgeon roe, cured
with salt — the only roe that carries the name.

What are the different types of caviar?

The classic three come from wild Caspian sturgeon: Beluga, Osetra, and Sevruga. Farming has since
widened the field, and the caviars commonly sold today also include Sterlet, Siberian, and Pacific
sturgeon, as well as Kaluga.

Caviar Russe specializes in Osetra — from Classic through the rare Almas grades — alongside a select
range of other sturgeon.

How is our caviar shipped?

All of our caviar is available for purchase from our boutiques in New York and Miami, and our online
caviar store for delivery and pickup. Caviar Russe New York, awarded a Michelin star each of the
past 10 years, is located on Madison Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, and Caviar Russe Miami is located
on Brickell Avenue in Downtown Miami.

Caviar Russe offers next-day express overnight FedEx delivery nationwide, for all of our caviar and
gourmet foods. FedEx generally delivers by early afternoon but delivery time will vary by region and
location. local delivery is available in Manhattan and Miami. In addition, Caviar Russe offers same
day pickup in both of Caviar Russe’s locations in New York and Miami.

Do you deliver in New York City?

Yes. We offer same-day delivery throughout Manhattan and select areas of Brooklyn, and overnight

# Home

#### Aquarius Finest Caviar

At [Aquarius Caviar][12], we bring unmatched expertise and passion to the world of fine caviar. As a
premier exporter, we offer more than just a product—we deliver an experience defined by quality,
authenticity, and exceptional service. Here’s why customers worldwide trust us:
* **Uncompromising Quality**: Our products are meticulously sourced from our farm who adhere to the
  highest standards of aquaculture.
* **Sustainably Sourced**: We prioritize ethical and sustainable practices, with our certified farm
  to protect sturgeon populations and maintain the balance of aquatic ecosystems.
* **Global Expertise**: With years of experience in the international market, we understand the
  complexities of exporting premium products. From streamlined logistics to secure packaging, we
  ensure that our caviar arrives in perfect condition, no matter where you are.
* **Diverse Selection**: Whether you seek the exquisite richness of Beluga, the nutty profile of
  Ossetra, or the bold character of Sevruga, we offer a curated selection of caviar to suit every
  taste and occasion.
* **Customer-Centric Approach**: Your satisfaction is our priority. From personalized
  recommendations to responsive support, we’re here to exceed your expectations at every step.

***When you choose Aquarius Caviar, you’re not just buying a product—you’re investing in a legacy of
excellence, trust, and indulgence. Partner with us to experience the finest caviar the world has to
offer.***

# Home

#### Aquarius Finest Caviar

At [Aquarius Caviar][12], we bring unmatched expertise and passion to the world of fine caviar. As a
premier exporter, we offer more than just a product—we deliver an experience defined by quality,
authenticity, and exceptional service. Here’s why customers worldwide trust us:
* **Uncompromising Quality**: Our products are meticulously sourced from our farm who adhere to the
  highest standards of aquaculture.
* **Sustainably Sourced**: We prioritize ethical and sustainable practices, with our certified farm
  to protect sturgeon populations and maintain the balance of aquatic ecosystems.
* **Global Expertise**: With years of experience in the international market, we understand the
  complexities of exporting premium products. From streamlined logistics to secure packaging, we
  ensure that our caviar arrives in perfect condition, no matter where you are.
* **Diverse Selection**: Whether you seek the exquisite richness of Beluga, the nutty profile of
  Ossetra, or the bold character of Sevruga, we offer a curated selection of caviar to suit every
  taste and occasion.
* **Customer-Centric Approach**: Your satisfaction is our priority. From personalized
  recommendations to responsive support, we’re here to exceed your expectations at every step.

### معرفی باهوخاویار

فروشگاه اینترنتی باهو خاويار متعلق به “شركت باهو خزر” با شماره ثبت ۲۱۰۱، نخستین توزیع کننده خاویار
شیلات ایران با بیش از ۲۵ سال سابقه درخشان به عنوان صادر كننده نمونه و تایید شده برای صادرات محصولات
دریایی به اتحادیه اروپا و روسیه شناخته شده و دارای تاییدیه سایتس بین الملل برای صادرات خاویار به
کلیه کشور هاست. شرکت باهو خزر در زمینه تولید، بسته بندی و فروش انواع خاویار ایرانی و صادراتی، بهترین
و معتبرترین تولیدکننده و فروشنده خاویار اصل و محصولات غذایی لوکس دریایی است.

این شرکت با کد پروانه بهداشتی ۹۳۵۰۲۰۲۱۹۱۰۶۱ روش‌های عمل‌آوری، بسته‌بندی، نگهداری، حمل و نقل و فروش
خاویار را به بهترین نحو ممکن انجام داده و همچنین با جدید‌ترین شیوه‌های عرضه این محصول در بازار آشنایی
کامل داشته و همواره در تلاش است تا ضمن توسعه سبد محصولات خود، خاویار و محصولات دیگر را با بالاترین کیفیت
و مطلوب‌ترین سرویس‌دهی به خریداران خود عرضه نماید. خاویار پرورشی شرکت “باهو خزر” از بهترین
پرورش‌دهندگان ماهیان خاویاری ایران در سواحل جنوبی دریای خزر و با بهترین کیفیت تامین می‌گردد.

دفتر اصلی شرکت باهو خزر در شهر تهران قرار دارد و همچنین این شرکت در بزرگترین شهرهای ایران (شیراز،
مشهد، گیلان، یزد، قم، کرمان، اصفهان و مازندران) 8 نمایندگی دارد.

### چرا باهو خاویار

یکی از مهم‌ترین فاکتورهای صادرات مواد غذایی به کشورهای اروپایی، کیفیت محصول است. شرکت باهو خزر،
همواره در تلاش است تا کیفیت سبد محصولات خود را در بالاترین حد ممکن حفظ کند و بهترین خدمات و محصولات را

#### تحویل ویژه تهران

مشتریان ساکن شهر تهران با ثبت سفارش محصول خود را در سریع ترین زمان ممکن درب منزل دریافت می‌کنند. در

از ساعت 13)، تحویل محصول تا 2 ساعت بعد از ثبت سفارش برای ساکنین و مشترکان تهران صورت می گیرد. همچنین
سفارشاتی که بعد از اتمام زمان اداری شرکت ثبت می‌شوند، در اولین ساعات کاری روز بعد ارسال می‌شوند.


#### تحویل در شهرستان های منتخب

مشتریانی که ساکن تهران نیستند پس از ثبت سفارش، محصول مورد نظر از طریق هواپیما و در سریعترین زمان

#### گستردگی روش‌های پرداخت

مشتریان برای خرید خاویار اصل یا دیگر محصولات لوکس غذایی می‌توانند از طریق پرداخت آنلاین، پرداخت در محل
و یا واریز به حساب جهت پرداخت هزینه سفارش خود اقدام کنند.

### INDULGE

While the sturgeon has been around for 200 million years, it wasn’t until the past decade that the
market for caviar began to get interesting. In September of 2007, California Caviar Company launched
the first sustainable caviar company in the world and the industry has not been the same since. From
its inception, California Caviar has been true to its core mission: sustainability, innovation and
education. Linking old world traditions with the new world of sustainable aquaculture and culinary
innovation, CCC has become a global leader in the production of sustainably farmed, premium caviar,
sought after by Michelin Star chefs, discriminating connoisseurs, and those just discovering the joy
of caviar. 


“The genesis of California Caviar Company was a direct response to consumer demand for a safe,
reliable purveyor of high-quality caviar. Our mission is to provide a premium sustainable product
that is controlled and guaranteed so our clients can trust and trace every egg from tank to tin.” 

     
~ Deborah Keane,
Caviar Queen

## Over 40 Years of Italian Caviar Expertise

Born in Lombardy, Italy, Calvisius combines decades of aquaculture expertise with Italian
craftsmanship to produce premium caviar trusted by chefs, gourmets, and caviar lovers around the
world.

Made in Italy

Crafted in Northern Italy, Calvisius caviar reflects the precision, elegance, and culinary heritage
of Italian gastronomy.

Sustainable Aquaculture

Produced through responsible aquaculture designed to protect wild sturgeon while ensuring
exceptional quality and freshness.

Traceable from Fish to Tin

Every tin is supported by clear origin and production details, helping ensure authenticity,
transparency, and confidence in every serving.

## Your Italian Caviar Questions, Answered

What is caviar?

True caviar refers to salt-cured roe from sturgeon. Calvisius caviar is produced from responsibly
farmed sturgeon and selected for freshness, texture, and refined flavor.

What makes Calvisius caviar Italian?

Calvisius caviar is produced in Italy, where sturgeon are raised in carefully managed aquaculture
environments using decades of expertise and a commitment to quality.

Is Calvisius caviar sustainable?

Yes. Calvisius caviar comes from responsible aquaculture, helping protect wild sturgeon populations
while delivering fresh, traceable, premium caviar.

What is the best way to serve Italian caviar?

Serve caviar chilled, using a mother-of-pearl spoon, and enjoy it on its own or with blinis, crème
fraîche, potatoes, eggs, or Champagne.

Which Calvisius caviar should I try first?

For a classic introduction, White Sturgeon caviar offers a smooth, buttery, balanced profile.
Oscietra and Sevruga offer more complex, refined tasting experiences.

Why Caviar de Beluga

## Built for *procurement*
## professionals

⬡

### Direct Import

We bypass middlemen entirely, importing directly from accredited farms to offer unbeatable wholesale
pricing without compromising on grade or provenance.

◈

### Private Label

Custom-branded tins, bespoke sizing, and tailored presentation formats — designed for hotels,
airlines, and retailers who want their own marque on the world's finest caviar.

◇

### Cold-Chain Integrity

From farm to your kitchen: −3 to 0°C maintained at every checkpoint. Insulated packaging with gel
ice packs. Next-day UK; temperature-controlled across Europe.

□

### Audit-Ready

Complete documentation for every shipment — SALSA certificates, spec sheets, batch traceability,
CITES paperwork, and allergen declarations. Your compliance team will thank you.

**Caviar**
The international definition of caviar is extremely strict and precise. Only fish roe products from
the sturgeon order can be called CAVIAR, which is also known as "black gold". Other similar foods,
such as red salmon caviar, are classified as "caviar substitutes". According to international
practice, CAVIAR does not have an exclusive brand, and products are only graded based on quality.
Caviar ranks among the world's three costliest delicacies alongside truffles and foie gras.

**How We Work **

Contains protein, DHA, EPA, amino acids, and lecithin, It also contains multiple vitamins and trace
elements. Protein, DHA, and EPA Caviar is a great intake choice. Caviar production, with only
imported salt added, Without any other treatment, ensure that nutrition is not damaged. ÉCLAIR
caviar operates under the standards of the entire industry chain,
CMA testing recognition ensures the taste experience of caviar.

**Company Profile**
Shangrao Sturgeon Huso Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional aquaculture enterprise established in
2021 with a registered capital of 95.8 million yuan. The company specializes in the breeding,
cultivation, processing, and sales of sturgeon, dedicated to creating high-quality sturgeon caviar
and its derivative products. Through close cooperation with the Yangtze River Fisheries Research
Institute, we continuously promote technological innovation and quality improvement in the sturgeon
industry, ensuring our products maintain a leading position in the market.

The company has sturgeon farms spread across Jiangxi, Yunnan, and Liaoning, with a total cultivation
area exceeding 600 acres and a breeding workshop of 5,000 square meters, achieving an annual
sturgeon cultivation total of ten million kilograms. We adopt advanced processing technologies and
traditional production techniques, strictly adhering to food safety management systems to ensure the
safety of our products from source to table. The daily production capacity of sturgeon caviar at
Shangrao Sturgeon Huso Technology Co., Ltd. reaches 1,000 kg. Our production lines are constructed
to a ten-thousand-level purification standard and are equipped with comprehensive transportation and
refrigeration facilities to maintain the freshness and quality of our products. We have obtained
international certifications including registeration for export food production enterprises, HACCP
system certification, and registration with the U.S. FDA, providing a solid guarantee for the
quality of our products exported to international markets. In addition to providing high-quality
ingredients, the company is committed to developing characteristic cultural tourism projects,
promoting the harmonious coexistence of sturgeon culture with nature, and attracting global
attention. Our sales network covers many different regions dedicated to providing high-quality
ingredients to global custom.


**Sturgeon Introduction**
——
Sturgeons are large, primitive, long-lived and late-maturing fishes among the existing fishes.
Sturgeons are considered to be living fossils. Their ancestors date back over 200 milion years, the

**Caviar**
The international definition of caviar is extremely strict and precise. Only fish roe products from
the sturgeon order can be called CAVIAR, which is also known as "black gold". Other similar foods,
such as red salmon caviar, are classified as "caviar substitutes". According to international
practice, CAVIAR does not have an exclusive brand, and products are only graded based on quality.
Caviar ranks among the world's three costliest delicacies alongside truffles and foie gras.

**Company Profile**
Shangrao Sturgeon Huso Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional aquaculture enterprise established in
2021 with a registered capital of 95.8 million yuan. The company specializes in the breeding,
cultivation, processing, and sales of sturgeon, dedicated to creating high-quality sturgeon caviar
and its derivative products. Through close cooperation with the Yangtze River Fisheries Research
Institute, we continuously promote technological innovation and quality improvement in the sturgeon
industry, ensuring our products maintain a leading position in the market.

The company has sturgeon farms spread across Jiangxi, Yunnan, and Liaoning, with a total cultivation
area exceeding 600 acres and a breeding workshop of 5,000 square meters, achieving an annual
sturgeon cultivation total of ten million kilograms. We adopt advanced processing technologies and
traditional production techniques, strictly adhering to food safety management systems to ensure the
safety of our products from source to table. The daily production capacity of sturgeon caviar at
Shangrao Sturgeon Huso Technology Co., Ltd. reaches 1,000 kg. Our production lines are constructed
to a ten-thousand-level purification standard and are equipped with comprehensive transportation and
refrigeration facilities to maintain the freshness and quality of our products. We have obtained
international certifications including registeration for export food production enterprises, HACCP
system certification, and registration with the U.S. FDA, providing a solid guarantee for the
quality of our products exported to international markets. In addition to providing high-quality
ingredients, the company is committed to developing characteristic cultural tourism projects,
promoting the harmonious coexistence of sturgeon culture with nature, and attracting global
attention. Our sales network covers many different regions dedicated to providing high-quality
ingredients to global custom.


**Sturgeon Introduction**
——
Sturgeons are large, primitive, long-lived and late-maturing fishes among the existing fishes.
Sturgeons are considered to be living fossils. Their ancestors date back over 200 milion years, the
same time as the dinosaurs. Sturgeon have been acknowledged as a tribute to royalty in many
countries. The Xibe people in China's Heilongjiang River Basin caught sturgeon as a delicacy for
emperors and empresses to taste and presented them to the imperial court for over 150 years.

### About Company

Empire Foods, a division of Empire Industries Limited, is a 126 years old public limited company
listed on the Mumbai stock exchange. It is a multifaceted conglomerate with an interest in diverse
business and assets of more than one billion US dollars. We are one of the largest importers and
distributors of frozen food in India. We import all kinds of seafood, meat, dairy, bakery and other
vegetarian products from all over the globe.

Empire Foods operates a well-established, state-of-the-art cold-chain distribution system across
India. Utilizing strategically located refrigeration facilities and dedicated teams of experts, our
logistics network ensures the freshness and integrity of every product during transit. This
guarantees swift and timely delivery, ensuring our customers receive the best quality products no
matter where they are in India. Through these industry best practices, Empire Foods continues to set
new standards in the frozen and chilled foods segment of India.
* ###### Our Mission
  
  To deliver high-quality, reliable food solutions that create value for customers.
* ###### Our Vision
  
  To be a leading and trusted food industry partner, recognized for innovation.


### Products Range

Discover our diverse selection of premium frozen and chilled food products sourced from trusted
global partners and delivered with assured quality.

2008(Basa)
Empire Foods introduced Basa for the first time in India in Nov 2008.
2010
Empire foods introduced Salmon from Scotland.
2011
In the year 2011, we introduced Salmon from Norway.
2012
This year, we introduced Lamb from Australia and New Zealand.
2013
One of the first companies to get a license from the Food safety and standards authority of India
2014
We become one of the leading importers in the food industry.
2015
We offered Prawns and Shrimps to our clients from Coastal India.
2016
Empire foods has been awarded "Independent Food & Grocery Retailer of the Year" by Food & Grocery in
2016.
2017
Empire foods have been awarded 'Category Champion for the year by Metro in 2017.
2018
Successfully launched premium caviar, expanding our gourmet product portfolio in India.
2019
Empire Foods introduced Nile perch fillets from Uganda, Fresh Salmon from Scotland and Chilean
Seabass from Sri Lanka
2021
Empire Foods introduced Spring Roll Bakery from Malaysia to India.
2022
Introduced premium imported cheeses from global markets to India.
2023
Launched Edamame & Mukimame sourced from Indonesia, expanding into premium plant-based offerings.
2024
Empire Foods introduced Whipping cream and Butter sheet from France to India. Also launched Crab
Stick from Thailand.
2025
Empire Foods is proud to have received the Annapoorna Inter Food Award for Best Importer of F&B
Products.

## Grand Exchange Market Watch


The Grand Exchange Market Watch is a project set up to monitor and record the prices and other
information on items on the Grand Exchange.

An index is a method of measuring the value of a section of the market. It is computed from the
prices of selected items. In a price-weighted index such as the [ Dow Jones Industrial Average
(DJIA) ][30], the price of each component item is the only consideration when determining the value
of the index. Items may be removed or added to indices over time, but the index will remain
"neutral" when that happens, following the method that the Wall Street Journal uses when the DJIA is
adjusted.

We track 9 separate market indexes ranging from Food to Runes, Metals to Herbs, including one
general "Market Index". All of which show the health of that aspect of the Old School RuneScape
economy.

helping serve the finest chefs, restaurants, hotels, bakeries and pastry shops, specialty stores and
private chef's with the best food the world has to offer. With over 3,000 imported and domestic
specialty food products, we can assist you with the best ingredients for every course: cheese,
charcuterie, imported and domestic caviars, fresh truffles, baking chocolates and baking
ingredients, the finest meat and seafood, spices, oils, vinegars and much more. [Setup a wholesale

should you have any questions.

migrate to the ocean where they spend most of their lives, and return to freshwater to spawn. Salmon
are powerful swimmers and play an important role in both natural ecosystems and human diets.

farming has expanded in northern provinces near the Caspian Sea and in some western regions with

## Ribbonfish

Ribbonfish belongs to the marine fish family. Ribbonfish has a long body and compressed sides that
give them a ribbon-like appearance. Ribbonfish swim in the open sea. Ribbonfish do not have anal
fins, but their dorsal fins are the same size as their bodies, and the fins on their stomach have 1
large and 9 small fin rays. Ribbonfish are rarely seen alive. Ribbonfish are usually dead and
floating on surfaces of the ocean. Ribbonfish is among economically valuable fish. Ribbonfish is
widely found in the Persian Gulf waters and Sea of Oman. Ribbonfish is one of the most important
fish stocks in the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman, which needs to be studied more in biological
and environmental fields. The habitat and fishing ground of ribbonfish is in Bushehr province and
the Mataf region in Dayer city. The fishing season of ribbonfish starts in May and continues until
September.

### largehead ribbonfish

Largehead ribbonfish lives in the sea and saltwater. Largehead ribbonfish is benthopelagic, meaning
they live in both beds and the surface of the sea. Largehead ribbonfish migrates to different
places. This fish lives at a depth of 589 meters and usually at 100 to 350 meters. Largehead
ribbonfish lives in subtropical waters. Largehead ribbonfish is found in tropical and temperate
waters of the world. It is commonly found above muddy beds in shallow coastal waters and often
enters estuaries.

OUR STORY

Founded in Miami in 1983, Marky’s Caviar is a premier gourmet food company specializing in caviar,
foie gras, truffles, and other delicacies. Our locations in Miami, New York City, and Boston offer a
curated selection of these products in both retail and dining settings. In addition to our retail
stores and restaurants, we supply consumers nationwide with Marky's caviar and other gourmet
products through our e-commerce platform, while also providing wholesale distribution to retailers,
restaurants, and more.

[Signature Offerings]
[Signature Offerings]

retail

Explore our locations throughout the country—Marky's Gourmet (Miami), Marky's Caviar (Boston),
Marky’s Caviar (Madison Ave.), Marky’s Caviar (Grand Central Market), Marky’s Caviar (Tribeca). Our
locations in the northeast feature our exclusive “Private Stock” caviars, some from our Sturgeon
Aquafarms, the sole legal producer of Beluga caviar in the USA, alongside other gourmet delights
like foie gras, truffles, smoked salmon, and more.

Restaurants

Nestled behind Marky’s Caviar retail shop on Madison Ave., Marky’s Caviar offers a fine-casual
dining experience with an all day à la carte menu is crafted by Corporate Executive Chef Buddha Lo,
a two-time Top Chef winner. It is the original location for our Michelin-plated Huso restaurant.
Originally opened in 2019, Huso has relocated to a larger, brighter space in Tribeca where we
provide a reimagined caviar-inspired tasting menu in the evenings. Our restaurant in Miami, Marky's
Caviar Lounge, features a more casual, all-day à la carte menu with American classics inspired by
caviar. All of our locations specialize in offering caviar service alongside our menus.

## Discover Mottra

### There’s a very good reason why Mottra Caviar is preferred over all other brands. From the time
### sturgeon enters the pure, filtered water of the Mottra tank, until caviar is shipped out for
### overnight delivery, Mottra is in complete control.

Mottra controls every stage of the production to bring you fresh malossol caviar at its finest.
Order now & enjoy already tomorrow. All caviar is processed and packaged on site under 100% sterile
conditions, and kept chilled at precise temperatures to ensure, this culinary delight arrives at
your door as fresh and delicious as at the day it was harvested.

For the connoisseurs of Mottra products we have opened one more opportunity. In our internet store
you can get familiar with all our products range, special offers and our popular sets. Order today
and get your excellence already tomorrow.

Please note before ordering: If we have distributor in your country, you have to contact with them
to complete your order, ordering from the local distributor guarantees price friendly delivery.

[Mottra Shop][13]

## Mottra Farm

SIA “MOTTRA” was established in 2002 in Latvia. It utilizes a closed-recirculating system of its own
design, making the process of growing fish and processing it: ecological, sustainable, fish and
environmentally.

Technology that is being used, has been designed in the beginning of 1990’s in Astrakhan, capital of
caviar production. It has been evolving ever since to keep up with the time and a new methodology.
Numerous patents allow SIA “MOTTRA” to have the most sophisticated closed recalculation systems.

The team is comprised of professionals with 40 year experience in fish production. The leading
biologists finished institute in Astrakhan with a specialization in sturgeon fish farming.

In 2007, SIA “MOTTRA” had received a caviar for the first time and thus laid the foundation to
Mottra Caviar House.

## Why Mottra

#### Crystal clean
#### pure caviar

Crystal clean pure caviar without any preservatives or any other chemicals that found in the caviar
from other producers.

#### No antibiotics
#### are used

No antibiotics are used due to fish tanks being concealed in the building from environment impact on
the livelihood of fish. No need to treat the fish due to absence of flying birds which transport
diseases in nature.

#### Pure artesian
#### water

Water is taken from artesian drill of 150 m deep for caviar production. Free of heavy metals,
radionuclide, pesticides, dioxins and other by-products of modern human life, which surrounds all of
us in everyday day life.

#### Always fresh
#### caviar

Unlike other producers who produce caviar only once in a Spring and Autumn, MOTTRA CAVIAR is
producing it everyday throughout the whole year, so on the Christmas Eve caviar will be as fresh as
on the Easter Holiday.

#### Perfect texture
#### & taste

Perfect texture and taste that has been reached by the know-how and the care caviar.

## Mottra
## in press

Mottra Caviar was mentioned in various popular magazines and newspaper publications, including:
* TATLER

* YesChef

## at events

Mottra Caviar is being served at an ever-increasing number of highly publicized black tie events,
like:
* Elton and David’s White Tie & Tiara Ball

## caviar tapas

Experience luxury with the Caviar Tapas, where creative pairings elevate every bite. Start with
*caviar taramasalata*, a creamy “fish roe” dip served with fresh vegetables. Along with *veal
dumplings*, squid ink dumplings filled with veal in a champagne caviar sauce. For a main, the
*linguine al caviale* combines squid ink pasta with a rich black caviar sauce. Finish with the
*molten lava cake*, blending warm chocolate and vanilla ice cream with a hint of caviar for a
sweet-savory treat.

# Types of Caviar

Sturgeon, or sturgeon, from the sturgeon family, is one of the few aquatic species that dates back
several hundred million years to the Jurassic Age, and therefore sturgeons are called living fossils
of the world, which together with their phylogenetic evolution have survived to the present day.
These fish are divided into 27 species and subspecies in the world, of which 6 species live in the
Caspian Sea.

## *Black Label*

##### The Black Label Caviar is as close to 100% sustainable and CO2 neutral as we can come in the
##### world of caviar.

Our Black Label caviar originates from the sturgeon Dauricus Schrenkii. The caviar is extracted when
the sturgeon reaches its second maturation at 12 years old, weighing between 65-105 kilograms.
Extracting the caviar at second maturation enhances its flavor and characteristics to create a truly
exquisite caviar that is superior in taste. The caviar matures for up to 12 weeks resulting in a
firm grain with a satisfyingly crisp texture, with a slightly nutty yet creamy taste that is both
bold and refined.

## *Black Label*

##### The Black Label Caviar is as close to 100% sustainable and CO2 neutral as we can come in the
##### world of caviar.

Our Black Label caviar originates from the sturgeon Dauricus Schrenkii. The caviar is extracted when
the sturgeon reaches its second maturation at 12 years old, weighing between 65-105 kilograms.
Extracting the caviar at second maturation enhances its flavor and characteristics to create a truly
exquisite caviar that is superior in taste. The caviar matures for up to 12 weeks resulting in a
firm grain with a satisfyingly crisp texture, with a slightly nutty yet creamy taste that is both
bold and refined.

## Once upon a time,a bold french gamble

In 2009, three French entrepreneurs – Delphyne, Christophe Dabezies, and Alexandre Guerrier – took
on a bold challenge: to create an exceptional caviar, combining traditional expertise, respect for
nature, and a sustainable vision. They chose a rare, untouched location: Madagascar. Nestled in a
natural haven at over 1,400 meters above sea level, they established the first sturgeon farm in the
Indian Ocean. Thus, Acipenser was born, an independent farm where every action is carried out with
precision and care. Far from any pollution, in a pristine environment, the sturgeons grow slowly,
nurtured with care, to produce exceptional roe, already served on the finest tables.

[
Discover
][63]
[Farm structures on lake site as seen from a drone]
[Rova Caviar box icon]

Rova Caviar, established on June 26, 2017, coinciding with Madagascar's national holiday, carries a
name steeped in national heritage. "Rova", a reference to the Queen's Palace that majestically
overlooks the capital city of Antananarivo, is a symbol of national pride and is emblematically
represented on its "Black Gold" caviar tins.

[Appetizer bite with caviar icon]

Rova Caviar goes beyond offering extraordinary quality pearls; it provides unparalleled tasting
experiences. By partnering with world-class Michelin-starred chefs and esteemed spirit distilleries,
Rova Caviar takes its collection to new heights with an assortment of unexpected and delightful
pairings. These strategic collaborations serve to refine the caviar's allure, forging a memorable
gastronomic adventure.

[Sturgeon icon]

is dedicated to preserving the art of caviar tasting. With plans to offer six exceptional caviars,
each sourced from a distinct pure sturgeon species, the brand aims to provide a diverse array of
tasting experiences. In the near future, the iconic **Beluga** and Sevruga caviars will be
introduced, further enriching this collection.

## ROYAL CAVIAR CLUB

THE UNIQUE TASTE

Royal Caviar Club was originally a project composed of a group of talented food lovers, with strict
pursuit of product quality and value. The unique taste and touch make Royal Caviar Club bring
together the most exquisite caviar in the world.

[Shop now][33]

## Its nobleness is not entirely due to its price, and even more so because of the unique taste of
## caviar, its status cannot be banned.

Caviar is often regarded as the most precious ingredient, luxurious and noble food culture. Its
nobleness is not entirely due to its price, and even more so because of the unique taste of caviar,
its status cannot be banned. Royal Caviar Club hopes to make everyone pay more attention to the
caviar food culture and bring you a unique experience.

In fact, caviar is not only an advanced ingredient, but also an attitude to life. Royal Caviar Club
provides a variety of top-quality caviar to make people feel the highest enjoyment, and is equipped
with appropriate tableware. This ensures that the taste of caviar is not destroyed, and the umami
and unique taste of caviar are fully displayed, making every feast perfect. In addition, the caviar
of Royal Caviar Club is carefully selected, and all caviar is guaranteed to ensure that the selected
sturgeon is of extremely high quality.

An example Golden mixed species caviar uses mature mixed species of sturgeon, while black gold

## OUR STORY

Sam’s Caviar traces its roots back to Moscow, Russia, where the founding family, with a rich
Armenian heritage, began its journey. The family was deeply embedded in the cultural tapestry of
Moscow, carrying with them generations of tradition, culinary expertise, and an unyielding spirit of
resilience. In 2004, driven by the pursuit of better opportunities and a prosperous future, the
family made the brave decision to emigrate to the United States.

Upon arriving in America, the patriarch faced numerous challenges. He began his new life working as
an ice cream truck driver in South-Central Inglewood, California. Despite the hardships, he remained
steadfast and dedicated, leveraging his skills and determination to overcome each obstacle. His
journey was marked by perseverance and an unwavering commitment to providing a better life for his
family.

With his culinary talents, he transitioned from driving an ice cream truck to working as a chef in a
local Los Angeles restaurant. His passion for food and relentless work ethic did not go unnoticed.
Over time, his reputation grew, and he became known for his exquisite dishes and innovative approach
to cuisine. This recognition paved the way for him to fulfill a long-held dream: owning his own
restaurant.

The establishment quickly became a beloved local favorite, celebrated for its unique blend of
traditional flavors and modern techniques. The restaurant's success was a testament to his hard
work, vision, and the strong support of his family. In 2020, inspired by his journey and the legacy
he wanted to leave behind, he founded Sam’s Caviar.

Sam’s Caviar was created with a vision to bring the finest caviar and seafood to discerning
customers. The company prides itself on sourcing premium products from renowned aqua farms across
the United States and around the world. Each product meets the highest standards of quality and

## OUR STORY

Sam’s Caviar traces its roots back to Moscow, Russia, where the founding family, with a rich
Armenian heritage, began its journey. The family was deeply embedded in the cultural tapestry of
Moscow, carrying with them generations of tradition, culinary expertise, and an unyielding spirit of
resilience. In 2004, driven by the pursuit of better opportunities and a prosperous future, the
family made the brave decision to emigrate to the United States.

Upon arriving in America, the patriarch faced numerous challenges. He began his new life working as
an ice cream truck driver in South-Central Inglewood, California. Despite the hardships, he remained
steadfast and dedicated, leveraging his skills and determination to overcome each obstacle. His
journey was marked by perseverance and an unwavering commitment to providing a better life for his
family.

With his culinary talents, he transitioned from driving an ice cream truck to working as a chef in a
local Los Angeles restaurant. His passion for food and relentless work ethic did not go unnoticed.
Over time, his reputation grew, and he became known for his exquisite dishes and innovative approach
to cuisine. This recognition paved the way for him to fulfill a long-held dream: owning his own
restaurant.

The establishment quickly became a beloved local favorite, celebrated for its unique blend of
traditional flavors and modern techniques. The restaurant's success was a testament to his hard
work, vision, and the strong support of his family. In 2020, inspired by his journey and the legacy
he wanted to leave behind, he founded Sam’s Caviar.

Sam’s Caviar was created with a vision to bring the finest caviar and seafood to discerning
customers. The company prides itself on sourcing premium products from renowned aqua farms across
the United States and around the world. Each product meets the highest standards of quality and
adheres to all legal requirements, ensuring that customers receive only the best.

Today, our company stands as a symbol of the family's dedication, perseverance, and passion for
excellence. The company's success is built on a foundation of hard work, integrity, and a commitment
to delivering unparalleled products. As Sam’s Caviar continues to grow, it remains true to its
roots, honoring the heritage and values that have shaped its journey.

Sam’s Caviar invites you to experience the exceptional quality and rich flavors that define its
offerings. Join us in celebrating a legacy of excellence and enjoy the finest caviar and seafood
that the world has to offer.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

### معرفی باهوخاویار

فروشگاه اینترنتی باهو خاويار متعلق به “شركت باهو خزر” با شماره ثبت ۲۱۰۱، نخستین توزیع کننده خاویار
شیلات ایران با بیش از ۲۵ سال سابقه درخشان به عنوان صادر كننده نمونه و تایید شده برای صادرات محصولات
دریایی به اتحادیه اروپا و روسیه شناخته شده و دارای تاییدیه سایتس بین الملل برای صادرات خاویار به
کلیه کشور هاست. شرکت باهو خزر در زمینه تولید، بسته بندی و فروش انواع خاویار ایرانی و صادراتی، بهترین
و معتبرترین تولیدکننده و فروشنده خاویار اصل و محصولات غذایی لوکس دریایی است.

این شرکت با کد پروانه بهداشتی ۹۳۵۰۲۰۲۱۹۱۰۶۱ روش‌های عمل‌آوری، بسته‌بندی، نگهداری، حمل و نقل و فروش
خاویار را به بهترین نحو ممکن انجام داده و همچنین با جدید‌ترین شیوه‌های عرضه این محصول در بازار آشنایی
کامل داشته و همواره در تلاش است تا ضمن توسعه سبد محصولات خود، خاویار و محصولات دیگر را با بالاترین کیفیت
و مطلوب‌ترین سرویس‌دهی به خریداران خود عرضه نماید. خاویار پرورشی شرکت “باهو خزر” از بهترین
پرورش‌دهندگان ماهیان خاویاری ایران در سواحل جنوبی دریای خزر و با بهترین کیفیت تامین می‌گردد.

دفتر اصلی شرکت باهو خزر در شهر تهران قرار دارد و همچنین این شرکت در بزرگترین شهرهای ایران (شیراز،
مشهد، گیلان، یزد، قم، کرمان، اصفهان و مازندران) 8 نمایندگی دارد.

شرکت باهوخزر در سال 1388 به عنوان صادرکننده نمونه استان گیلان انتخاب شده است. این مجموعه تنها تولید
کننده ماهی استروژن دودی در کشور است و همچنین از به‌روزترین تکنولوژی و ماشین آلات اروپایی برای دودی
کردن انواع ماهی استفاده می‌کند.

شرکت باهوخزر به واسطه فعالیت 25 ساله خود در زمینه تولید و فروش خاویار ایرانی در بسیاری از زمینه‌ها
پیش قدم بوده و جزء اولین‌هاست. همچنین این مجموعه اولین و بزرگترین صادرکنندۀ محصولات دریایی به اروپا و
روسیه؛ اولین شرکت ایرانی صادرکنندۀ «شاه‌میگوی آب شیرین سد ارس» به اروپا و اولین شرکت ایرانی
تولیدکنندۀ کیلکا ماریناد شده و ماهی استورژن دودی‌شده است.

کلیه محصولات غذایی در فروشگاه اینترنتی باهو خاویار با مجوز وزارت بهداشت و دامپزشکی به فروش می‌رسد.

مشتریان ساکن شهر تهران با ثبت سفارش محصول خود را در سریع ترین زمان ممکن درب منزل دریافت می‌کنند. در
صورت ثبت سفارش تا قبل از پایان زمان اداری شرکت (شنبه تا چهارشنبه تا قبل از ساعت 17 و پنجشنبه تا قبل
از ساعت 13)، تحویل محصول تا 2 ساعت بعد از ثبت سفارش برای ساکنین و مشترکان تهران صورت می گیرد. همچنین
سفارشاتی که بعد از اتمام زمان اداری شرکت ثبت می‌شوند، در اولین ساعات کاری روز بعد ارسال می‌شوند.


#### تحویل در شهرستان های منتخب

مشتریانی که ساکن تهران نیستند پس از ثبت سفارش، محصول مورد نظر از طریق هواپیما و در سریعترین زمان
ممکن ارسال می‌شود.


#### گستردگی روش‌های پرداخت

مشتریان برای خرید خاویار اصل یا دیگر محصولات لوکس غذایی می‌توانند از طریق پرداخت آنلاین، پرداخت در محل
و یا واریز به حساب جهت پرداخت هزینه سفارش خود اقدام کنند.


برخی دیگر از ویژگی‌های منحصر به فرد و دستاوردهای شرکت باهو خزر به شرح زیر است:
* 25 سال سابقۀ با افتخار در زمینه تولید و صادرات خاویار و محصولات غذایی دریایی؛
* صادرکنندۀ نمونۀ استان گیلان در سال 1388؛
* تنها تولیدکنندۀ ماهی استورژن د

### INDULGE

While the sturgeon has been around for 200 million years, it wasn’t until the past decade that the
market for caviar began to get interesting. In September of 2007, California Caviar Company launched
the first sustainable caviar company in the world and the industry has not been the same since. From
its inception, California Caviar has been true to its core mission: sustainability, innovation and
education. Linking old world traditions with the new world of sustainable aquaculture and culinary
innovation, CCC has become a global leader in the production of sustainably farmed, premium caviar,
sought after by Michelin Star chefs, discriminating connoisseurs, and those just discovering the joy
of caviar. 


“The genesis of California Caviar Company was a direct response to consumer demand for a safe,
reliable purveyor of high-quality caviar. Our mission is to provide a premium sustainable product
that is controlled and guaranteed so our clients can trust and trace every egg from tank to tin.” 

     
~ Deborah Keane,
Caviar Queen

## Your Italian Caviar Questions, Answered

What is caviar?

True caviar refers to salt-cured roe from sturgeon. Calvisius caviar is produced from responsibly
farmed sturgeon and selected for freshness, texture, and refined flavor.

What makes Calvisius caviar Italian?

Calvisius caviar is produced in Italy, where sturgeon are raised in carefully managed aquaculture
environments using decades of expertise and a commitment to quality.

Is Calvisius caviar sustainable?

Yes. Calvisius caviar comes from responsible aquaculture, helping protect wild sturgeon populations
while delivering fresh, traceable, premium caviar.

What is the best way to serve Italian caviar?

Serve caviar chilled, using a mother-of-pearl spoon, and enjoy it on its own or with blinis, crème
fraîche, potatoes, eggs, or Champagne.

Which Calvisius caviar should I try first?

For a classic introduction, White Sturgeon caviar offers a smooth, buttery, balanced profile.
Oscietra and Sevruga offer more complex, refined tasting experiences.

### Beluga Imperial

Huso huso · Caspian Sea

The pinnacle of luxury. Large, lustrous pearls with a delicate, buttery flavour and a silky,
melt-on-tongue finish. Revered by connoisseurs for centuries.

Pearl Size 3.0 – 3.5 mm
Colour Silver-Grey

### Golden Almas

Acipenser persicus · Iran

The rarest caviar in the world. Luminous golden pearls harvested from mature albino sturgeon, prized
for an extraordinarily delicate, nutty flavour with a creamy finish.

Pearl Size 2.5 – 3.0 mm
Colour Pure Gold
Texture Creamy, smooth
Flavour Nutty, delicate, ethereal
[Inquire][8]
Chef's Choice

### Osetra Royal

Acipenser gueldenstaedtii · Caspian Sea

Rich, nutty complexity with oceanic undertones. Golden-brown pearls with a firm pop and a long,
elegant finish. The benchmark for the world's finest chefs.

Pearl Size 2.5 – 3.0 mm
Colour Amber-Gold
Texture Firm, satisfying pop
Flavour Nutty, briny, complex
[Inquire][9]

### Sevruga Classic

Acipenser stellatus · Caspian Sea

Intensely flavoured with a bold, briny character. Small, elegant pearls deliver the most pronounced
taste of any sturgeon caviar — a true connoisseur's choice.

Pearl Size 1.5 – 2.0 mm
Colour Dark Grey
Texture Fine, glossy
Flavour Bold, briny, intense
[Inquire][10]

Texture Smooth, buttery
Flavour Creamy, sweet, lingering
[Inquire][11]

### Siberian Baeri

Acipenser baerii · Siberian Waters

Glossy black pearls with a creamy, earthy flavour and exquisite texture. Clean and versatile —
perfect for creative culinary applications.

Pearl Size 2.0 – 2.5 mm
Colour Jet Black
Texture Glossy, firm
Flavour Earthy, creamy, clean
[Inquire][12]

**Caviar**
The international definition of caviar is extremely strict and precise. Only fish roe products from
the sturgeon order can be called CAVIAR, which is also known as "black gold". Other similar foods,
such as red salmon caviar, are classified as "caviar substitutes". According to international
practice, CAVIAR does not have an exclusive brand, and products are only graded based on quality.
Caviar ranks among the world's three costliest delicacies alongside truffles and foie gras.

**How We Work **

Contains protein, DHA, EPA, amino acids, and lecithin, It also contains multiple vitamins and trace
elements. Protein, DHA, and EPA Caviar is a great intake choice. Caviar production, with only
imported salt added, Without any other treatment, ensure that nutrition is not damaged. ÉCLAIR
caviar operates under the standards of the entire industry chain,
CMA testing recognition ensures the taste experience of caviar.

**Company Profile**
Shangrao Sturgeon Huso Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional aquaculture enterprise established in
2021 with a registered capital of 95.8 million yuan. The company specializes in the breeding,
cultivation, processing, and sales of sturgeon, dedicated to creating high-quality sturgeon caviar
and its derivative products. Through close cooperation with the Yangtze River Fisheries Research
Institute, we continuously promote technological innovation and quality improvement in the sturgeon
industry, ensuring our products maintain a leading position in the market.

The company has sturgeon farms spread across Jiangxi, Yunnan, and Liaoning, with a total cultivation
area exceeding 600 acres and a breeding workshop of 5,000 square meters, achieving an annual
sturgeon cultivation total of ten million kilograms. We adopt advanced processing technologies and
traditional production techniques, strictly adhering to food safety management systems to ensure the
safety of our products from source to table. The daily production capacity of sturgeon caviar at
Shangrao Sturgeon Huso Technology Co., Ltd. reaches 1,000 kg. Our production lines are constructed
to a ten-thousand-level purification standard and are equipped with comprehensive transportation and
refrigeration facilities to maintain the freshness and quality of our products. We have obtained
international certifications including registeration for export food production enterprises, HACCP
system certification, and registration with the U.S. FDA, providing a solid guarantee for the
quality of our products exported to international markets. In addition to providing high-quality
ingredients, the company is committed to developing characteristic cultural tourism projects,
promoting the harmonious coexistence of sturgeon culture with nature, and attracting global
attention. Our sales network covers many different regions dedicated to providing high-quality
ingredients to global custom.


**Sturgeon Introduction**
——
Sturgeons are large, primitive, long-lived and late-maturing fishes among the existing fishes.
Sturgeons are considered to be living fossils. Their ancestors date back over 200 milion years, the
same time as the dinosaurs. Sturgeon have been acknowledged as a tribute to royalty in many
countries. The Xibe people in China's Heilongjiang River Basin caught sturgeon as a delicacy for
emperors and empresses to taste and presented them to the imperial court for over 150 years.

## Grand Exchange Market Watch


The Grand Exchange Market Watch is a project set up to monitor and record the prices and other
information on items on the Grand Exchange.

An index is a method of measuring the value of a section of the market. It is computed from the
prices of selected items. In a price-weighted index such as the [ Dow Jones Industrial Average
(DJIA) ][30], the price of each component item is the only consideration when determining the value
of the index. Items may be removed or added to indices over time, but the index will remain
"neutral" when that happens, following the method that the Wall Street Journal uses when the DJIA is
adjusted.

We track 9 separate market indexes ranging from Food to Runes, Metals to Herbs, including one
general "Market Index". All of which show the health of that aspect of the Old School RuneScape
economy.

expertise, discernment, and an enduring appreciation for the extraordinary. IKRAA was born from that
foundation: a timeless sensibility, now reinterpreted for the modern connoisseur.

through a modern lens of sustainability, precision, and understated sophistication. It is a quiet
return to excellence, led with intention and crafted for those who appreciate the details.

An Elevated Standard

At IKRAA, caviar is not simply sourced—it is selected with intention. We work exclusively with
established farms across Europe and Asia, where time-honored techniques and modern expertise
converge. The result is a product of quiet distinction: elegant in taste, impeccable in texture, and
true to its origin.

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

### Visit our boutique

Located in **14 Wall Street, Manhattan, New York City**. Directly across from the New York Stock
Exchange. Shop our caviar, seafood, dips, spreads, and more.

## caviar tapas

Experience luxury with the Caviar Tapas, where creative pairings elevate every bite. Start with
*caviar taramasalata*, a creamy “fish roe” dip served with fresh vegetables. Along with *veal
dumplings*, squid ink dumplings filled with veal in a champagne caviar sauce. For a main, the
*linguine al caviale* combines squid ink pasta with a rich black caviar sauce. Finish with the
*molten lava cake*, blending warm chocolate and vanilla ice cream with a hint of caviar for a
sweet-savory treat.

[Learn More][85]

The hallmark of an afternoon tea featuring gourmet delectable scones, canapés, macarons, croissants,
and of course, caviar. Available daily from 12pm-4pm.

## Once upon a time,a bold french gamble

In 2009, three French entrepreneurs – Delphyne, Christophe Dabezies, and Alexandre Guerrier – took
on a bold challenge: to create an exceptional caviar, combining traditional expertise, respect for
nature, and a sustainable vision. They chose a rare, untouched location: Madagascar. Nestled in a
natural haven at over 1,400 meters above sea level, they established the first sturgeon farm in the
Indian Ocean. Thus, Acipenser was born, an independent farm where every action is carried out with
precision and care. Far from any pollution, in a pristine environment, the sturgeons grow slowly,
nurtured with care, to produce exceptional roe, already served on the finest tables.

## OUR STORY

Sam’s Caviar traces its roots back to Moscow, Russia, where the founding family, with a rich
Armenian heritage, began its journey. The family was deeply embedded in the cultural tapestry of
Moscow, carrying with them generations of tradition, culinary expertise, and an unyielding spirit of
resilience. In 2004, driven by the pursuit of better opportunities and a prosperous future, the
family made the brave decision to emigrate to the United States.

Upon arriving in America, the patriarch faced numerous challenges. He began his new life working as
an ice cream truck driver in South-Central Inglewood, California. Despite the hardships, he remained
steadfast and dedicated, leveraging his skills and determination to overcome each obstacle. His
journey was marked by perseverance and an unwavering commitment to providing a better life for his
family.

With his culinary talents, he transitioned from driving an ice cream truck to working as a chef in a
local Los Angeles restaurant. His passion for food and relentless work ethic did not go unnoticed.
Over time, his reputation grew, and he became known for his exquisite dishes and innovative approach
to cuisine. This recognition paved the way for him to fulfill a long-held dream: owning his own
restaurant.

The establishment quickly became a beloved local favorite, celebrated for its unique blend of
traditional flavors and modern techniques. The restaurant's success was a testament to his hard
work, vision, and the strong support of his family. In 2020, inspired by his journey and the legacy
he wanted to leave behind, he founded Sam’s Caviar.

Sam’s Caviar was created with a vision to bring the finest caviar and seafood to discerning
customers. The company prides itself on sourcing premium products from renowned aqua farms across
the United States and around the world. Each product meets the highest standards of quality and
adheres to all legal requirements, ensuring that customers receive only the best.

Today, our company stands as a symbol of the family's dedication, perseverance, and passion for
excellence. The company's success is built on a foundation of hard work, integrity, and a commitment
to delivering unparalleled products. As Sam’s Caviar continues to grow, it remains true to its
roots, honoring the heritage and values that have shaped its journey.

Sam’s Caviar invites you to experience the exceptional quality and rich flavors that define its
offerings. Join us in celebrating a legacy of excellence and enjoy the finest caviar and seafood
that the world has to offer.

## OUR STORY

Sam’s Caviar traces its roots back to Moscow, Russia, where the founding family, with a rich
Armenian heritage, began its journey. The family was deeply embedded in the cultural tapestry of
Moscow, carrying with them generations of tradition, culinary expertise, and an unyielding spirit of
resilience. In 2004, driven by the pursuit of better opportunities and a prosperous future, the
family made the brave decision to emigrate to the United States.

Upon arriving in America, the patriarch faced numerous challenges. He began his new life working as
an ice cream truck driver in South-Central Inglewood, California. Despite the hardships, he remained
steadfast and dedicated, leveraging his skills and determination to overcome each obstacle. His
journey was marked by perseverance and an unwavering commitment to providing a better life for his
family.

With his culinary talents, he transitioned from driving an ice cream truck to working as a chef in a
local Los Angeles restaurant. His passion for food and relentless work ethic did not go unnoticed.
Over time, his reputation grew, and he became known for his exquisite dishes and innovative approach
to cuisine. This recognition paved the way for him to fulfill a long-held dream: owning his own
restaurant.

The establishment quickly became a beloved local favorite, celebrated for its unique blend of
traditional flavors and modern techniques. The restaurant's success was a testament to his hard
work, vision, and the strong support of his family. In 2020, inspired by his journey and the legacy
he wanted to leave behind, he founded Sam’s Caviar.

Sam’s Caviar was created with a vision to bring the finest caviar and seafood to discerning
customers. The company prides itself on sourcing premium products from renowned aqua farms across
the United States and around the world. Each product meets the highest standards of quality and
adheres to all legal requirements, ensuring that customers receive only the best.

Today, our company stands as a symbol of the family's dedication, perseverance, and passion for
excellence. The company's success is built on a foundation of hard work, integrity, and a commitment
to delivering unparalleled products. As Sam’s Caviar continues to grow, it remains true to its
roots, honoring the heritage and values that have shaped its journey.

Sam’s Caviar invites you to experience the exceptional quality and rich flavors that define its
offerings. Join us in celebrating a legacy of excellence and enjoy the finest caviar and seafood
that the world has to offer.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

Private Dining

## Cellar Z

One of Portland & Lake Oswego’s hidden gems and most unique private dining rooms. Cellar Z was
created as a place to enjoy the best of food & wine. These private dining rooms, situated in the
basement of each store, house a collection of rare and fine wines and are ideal for corporate
dinners, wine receptions or celebratory meals.

## A Place for Tastemakers

Zupan’s Markets is a local and family-owned specialty market focusing on the best fresh, quality
ingredients. Step into our stores and be inspired for your next great meal. Our stores cater to
tastemakers. From [farm fresh produce][68] and [high-quality meats][69] to [aged cheese][70] and
[wine][71], our departments are filled with the best-curated selection in Portland.
